payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model utilizes visual contexts to improve its predictions of named entities, suggesting that it inspects the relationship between image parts and words related to entities.

claims.text: The model successfully predicts tokens as named entities by leveraging visual contexts that provide similarities to the token's distributional semantics.
Visual contexts help disambiguate tokens, allowing the model to correctly classify entities that would otherwise be misidentified.
The modality attention module enhances entity type recognition by combining representations from visual and textual modalities.
